title: Janus P vs NP proof-carrying research roadmap

mission.global_goal: Develop a fully exact, proof-carrying polynomial-time route strong enough to address the target NP-hard frontier without exceeding proven scope.

rules: Open-access/source audit before or together with each new gate depending on external facts.
Finite PASS proves only its frozen finite domain unless a separate theorem lifts it.
Diagnostic != theorem; NOT_ESTABLISHED != FALSE; terminal failure != hardness.
Every representation/reduction must preserve semantics exactly.
Do not mechanically escalate separator size, treewidth, backdoor size, or repair depth.
P7_FREE_4_COLOR_IN_P remains NOT_PROVED until an end-to-end polynomial chain exists.
P_VS_NP remains OPEN until a complete valid complexity-theoretic bridge is separately proved.

current_assets.c11: Authoritative P7-free C11 survivor lineage, quantified escape gates, separator/connectivity diagnostics, PI partial discovery.
current_assets.pipeline: {c,f} -> unique hub z -> reachability lattice -> canonical X -> nu(X)=rho_G(c,f) -> lambda(c,f) -> optional kappa(G)

phases.name: SOURCE_AND_FRONTIER_WATCH
phases.goal: Continuously check public/open-access literature and materials before promotion.
actions: Search papers, preprints, theses, errata, public code, datasets, supplementary files, proof artifacts and benchmark corpora.
Bind imported theorems to exact primary-source hypotheses.
If a known theorem closes or blocks the frontier, formalize/import it instead of running a redundant gate.

phases.name: C11_EXACT_CHANNEL_APPLICABILITY_SURVEY
phases.goal: Map which new authoritative C11 residuals admit the pure exact-channel normal form.
actions: Enumerate unordered anchor pairs.
Require nonedge anchors with singleton common neighbour.
Run one directed-reachability instance per eligible pair.
Record R_min, R_max, flexible SCC poset, canonical ports and X.
Record failures by forced-R -> forced-L implication path.

phases.name: TRANSFER_MECHANISM_CLASSIFICATION
phases.goal: Separate local invariant computation from explanation of local-to-global transfer.
actions: Compute k=nu(X)=rho_G(c,f).
Certify lambda(c,f)=k+1 by matching plus minimum vertex cover.
Compute exact global kappa(G) independently.
Classify kappa=lambda versus a local-global gap.
When equality holds, identify the structural mechanism: block robustness, component-refined reconnection, hub redundancy, cover geometry, or another theorem.

phases.name: NON_EXACT_CHANNEL_RESIDUAL_ANALYSIS
phases.goal: Study authoritative residuals that fail pure exact-channel representation.
actions: Extract minimal negative reachability certificates.
Cluster failure modes.
Search literature before defining any new descriptor.
Only formalize a new interface if a reusable graph-only structure is actually isolated.

phases.name: PI_DISCOVERY_COMPLETION
phases.goal: Resolve the remaining polynomial-discovery bottleneck for PI semantics or bypass it with a proved replacement.
actions: Revisit P3_EXACT_PAIR_QUOTIENT with theorem/source authority only.
Seek graph/list-derived signatures determining the <=16 PI masks exactly.
Do not use extension-oracle knowledge for discovery.

phases.name: LEMMA11_P7_TRANSFER_OR_REPLACEMENT
phases.goal: Close the C11 acceptability gap for P7-free graphs.
branches: Prove a legitimate P7 analogue/lift of Lemma 11 under exact hypotheses.
Or replace the failed mechanism with a new exact polynomial proof-carrying reduction.

phases.name: END_TO_END_P7_FREE_4_COLOR_PIPELINE
phases.goal: Assemble a complete P7-free 4-coloring algorithm only after all upstream pieces are proved.
required: polynomial total state/branch count and per-state cost
phases.promotion: Only then may P7_FREE_4_COLOR_IN_P move to PROVED.

phases.name: GENERALIZATION_FIREWALL
phases.goal: Determine exactly what a restricted-class polynomial algorithm implies beyond that class.
actions: Identify the required complexity-theoretic reduction.
Verify NP-completeness under the relevant reduction notion.
Verify the algorithm covers the reduction image without hidden blowup or semantic mismatch.

phases.name: P_VS_NP_PROMOTION_GATE
phases.goal: Permit a P=NP consequence only after a complete independently checkable bridge from an NP-complete problem to the proved polynomial algorithm exists.

priority: R8 P vs NP promotion gate
deliberately_not_opened: NEW_DESCRIPTOR without source audit and structural need

milestones.M1: Exact-channel applicability mapped on new authoritative C11 residuals.
milestones.M2: PI discovery becomes exact polynomial, or a proved replacement bypasses it.
milestones.M3: Lemma11 P7 gap closed by transfer or replacement.
milestones.M4: Complete P7-free 4-coloring pipeline with polynomial total complexity and replayable certificates.
milestones.M5: If warranted, verified reduction bridge to a general NP-complete problem.

every_major_claim: source references where external facts are used

authority_note: Planning/continuity authority only; this roadmap does not itself promote scientific claims.
